[SWS_DM_00959] Default value for DTC "aging counter down" if aging is not allowed
⌈
If the element DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps.aging does not
exist and the configuration parameter DiagnosticProvidedDataMapping.dat-
aProvider of the corresponding DiagnosticParameter.dataElement is set to
DEM_AGINGCTR_DOWNCNT, the DM shall set the respective DiagnosticExtended-
DataRecord’s DiagnosticDataElement value to DiagnosticAging.thresh-
old if configured or ’255’ otherwise.
⌋
